name: Agglayer Summit
text: A satirical campaign film for Agglayer Summit at Devcon Thailand 2024, centered on the idea of different chains coexisting with each other.

name: StarkHack
text: A bold, quirky film for StarkWare, telling the story of a coder being dragged into a police station for writing code too well.

name: Aptos Code Collision
text: The first film in a two-part campaign for Aptos Code Collision, made for India’s developer audience to drive hackathon participation.

name: Aptos Code Collision
text: The second film in the campaign for Aptos Code Collision, extending the same playful approach to bring more developers into the hackathon

name: Solana Roast Video
text: A playful response film to solana’s crypto campaign, reimagined with a more chaotic and comedic tone.

name: Biconomy (Types of people you meet at web3 events)
text: A playful film about the different kinds of people you’re likely to run into at a Web3 event.
